      How it Feels

      Seat Comfort

      Softer, sink-in comfort with relaxed feel

      Seat Depth

      Medium seat depth for universal comfort

      Seat Height

      Closer to dining chair height; easy to get in and out of

      Stevens

      Available in two seat depths, the Stevens sofa has a taller seat height combined with soft yet supportive cushions, delivering exceptional comfort with an upright feel. Stylish metal or wood legs elevate the look of this movie-night-worthy sofa.

      Made in United States

      of US and imported materials

      Meet the North Carolina craftspeople

      Details
      • Construction: benchmade hardwood frame with
      • Cushion Style: 2 seat, loose; loose back
      • Cushion Characteristics: plush yet supportive sit with a relaxed look; will slightly soften and settle with use; some feather loss is normal
      • Seat Cushion: spring and down
      • Back Cushion: fiber down blend
      • Cushion Care: down cushion
      • Warning: California residents Proposition 65
      • Item Number: 10009702

      • Spring & down cushion: encased coils surrounded by high-resiliency CertiPUR-US® certified foam, wrapped in fiber, feather and down, covered by down-proof ticking

      Dimensions
      • Overall: 81"w 37"d 30"h (34"h with cushion)
      • Inside Width: 72"
      • Arm Height: 24"
      • Seat Height: 19"
      • Seat Depth: 23"
      • Leg Height: 4"
      • Leg Thickness: 1.5"
      • Legs: all are removable
      • Approximate Product Weight: 150 lbs.
        Materials
        • Fabric: Sumner ivory
          Fabric Content: 100% polypropylene
          Features: Solid; Plain weave; Family friendly; Performance; Fade resistant; Responsibly made; Pet friendly
          Responsibly made: Cleaner chemistry; Commercial durability; Low emissions; Sustainable materials
          Fabric and upholstery care
        • Leg Finish: Walnut
          Wood care
        Origin
        • Product Origin: made in North Carolina
        • Material Origin: United States and imported
